manifest.name: dsh-think-zh-plus
manifest.description: DSH plugin: reason in Chinese (system-prompt section) + auto-expand every reasoning row in the Web UI
manifest.author: wuaisaber

bundle.text:
# dsh-think-zh-plus bundle layer: one Host-plane row.
#
# The row mounts the host half (system-prompt section). The browser half is
# declared by `dsh.client` in package.json and loads with the Web UI.
- insert:
    - id: think-zh-plus
      name: 'dsh-think-zh-plus'
      config:
        language: 简体中文
        target: think
        enabled: true

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 中文

一个插件同时做两件事：

1. **中文思考**：向每个请求的 system prompt 注入一段语言规则（order `-999`，紧跟身份段、在所有人设/工具说明之前），要求内部推理使用简体中文，代码/命令/路径/报错原样保留。
2. **思考常显**：浏览器端用 `MutationObserver` 监听对话区，把折叠状态的 `Think` 行自动点开；流式输出时思考内容实时可见。你手动折叠/展开过的行会被记住，插件不再碰它。展开的思考块会加一条左侧细线，和最终回复区分开。

readme.section: 和另外两个插件的关系
readme.text:
| | dsh-think-zh | dsh-plugin-think-zh | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 中文思考 | system prompt 段落（全局） | 拷贝一份 `code` 预设 | system prompt 段落（全局） |
| 自动展开 | 无 | 有（DOM 补丁） | 有（DOM 补丁） |
| 安装 | GitHub / 本地 | 手工跑 `install.ps1`、改配置 | 本地目录，`dsh plugin add` |
| 作用范围 | 所有会话、子代理 | 仅新建且选中该预设的会话 | 所有会话、子代理 |

**不要和 dsh-think-zh 同时装**：两者都注册 `agent:reasoning-language` 段落，会重复注入。
```powershell

readme.section: 从 GitHub 安装（现在就能用）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wuaisaber/dsh-think-zh-plus

readme.section: 从 npm 安装（发布后）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-think-zh-plus
```

`--profile` 用应用实际启动的那个：DSH Desktop 是 `desktop`，`dsh web` 是 `web`。装完重启应用或刷新页面。

readme.section: 让整个 Turn 不折叠
readme.text:
DSH 的 `standard`/`detailed` 模式会在 Turn 结束后折叠整段处理过程。把工作详情模式改成 `verbose`（唯一不折叠的模式），思考才会像回复一样直接铺在对话流里：

```yaml
- id: ui-chat
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat"
  config:
    transcriptView: verbose

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:<你的路径>/dsh-think-zh-plus"
```

在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖（用户 patch 层，升级不丢）：

```yaml
- id: think-zh-plus
  config:
    language: 简体中文
    target: think      # think = 只约束思考；all = 思考 + 回复都强制

- 只处理 `[data-variant="think"]` 且未展开（无 `data-expanded`）的行；点击的是行自带的 `[data-disclosure-row][data-expandable]`，走组件自己的 `onToggle`，不碰 React 内部状态。
- 你**手动**点过（pointerdown / Enter / Space）的行会加入 `WeakSet`，之后不再自动展开——避免"想收起来却被立刻弹开"。
- 插件卸载 / 热更新时通过 `ctx.effect` 的 disposer 断开观察器并移除监听。
- 依赖的 DOM 契约来自 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的 `ReasoningRow`（`data-variant="think"`、`data-state`、`data-expanded`、`data-disclosure-row`、`aria-expanded`）。DSH 大版本升级后若 UI 结构变化，需要同步改 `client.js`。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-think-zh-plus
```

```powershell
node --test test/host.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs
```

- `test/host.test.mjs`：配置 schema、文案、section order、disposer。
- `test/client.test.mjs`：用最小 DOM mock 验证首屏展开、后续行展开、手动折叠后不再打扰、卸载后停止。

MIT。Host 半段（system prompt 文案与配置 schema）改编自 [lance808/dsh-think-zh](https://github.com/lance808/dsh-think-zh)（MIT）；自动展开的 DOM 契约参考了 [cygrtt/dsh-plugin-think-zh](https://github.com/cygrtt/dsh-plugin-think-zh)（MIT）与 [dsh-think-ux](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-think-ux)（MIT），代码为本仓库重写。

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin with two halves:

1. **Chinese reasoning** — contributes a system-prompt section that asks the model to think in Simplified Chinese, with code, commands, paths and errors kept verbatim.
2. **Always-visible thinking** — a browser half that auto-expands every collapsed `Think` row in the Web UI and keeps thinking visually distinct from the final answer.

DSH's model usually reasons in English even when the user writes Chinese, and every reasoning row starts folded; a long Turn additionally folds its whole process block. This plugin makes the reasoning channel Chinese and keeps every Think row open, without touching React internals.
```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wuaisaber/dsh-think-zh-plus

dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-think-zh-plus
```

Use the profile that the app actually boots (`desktop` for DSH Desktop, `web` for `dsh web`). Restart the app or refresh the page afterwards.

To avoid DSH folding the whole completed Turn (not just the Think row), set the work-details mode to `verbose` in the profile patch:yaml
- id: ui-chat
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat"
  config:
    transcriptView: verbose
```

```yaml
- id: think-zh-plus
  name: dsh-think-zh-plus
  config:
    language: 简体中文   # any language name

Section order is `-999` (right after the harness identity, before the persona) — a rule placed late in DSH's long English prompt was ignored in practice.

- Auto-expansion clicks the row's own `data-disclosure-row` element, i.e. the component's supported toggle. It never calls React internals.
- A row the reader toggles by hand is remembered in a `WeakSet` and left alone.
- Injected style: an expanded Think block gets a thin left rule so it cannot be confused with the answer.
- Diagnostics: `window.__DSH_THINK_ZH_PLUS__` exposes `{ loadedAt, applied, scans, rowsSeen, expanded, lastError }`.
- Tested against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (DOM contract of `ReasoningRow` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat`).

```sh
node --test test/host.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs
```

MIT. The host-half instruction text and config schema are adapted from [lance808/dsh-think-zh](https://github.com/lance808/dsh-think-zh) (MIT). The DOM contract follows DSH's own `ReasoningRow`; the client code is original.
